subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: During negotiations, a vendor absolutely refuses to sign the contract unless the agency agrees to remove the standard 'Governing Law' clause that designates the agency's home state. The procurement officer should:
options: Remove the clause to expedite the award
Change the governing law to the vendor's state
Halt negotiations and consult with legal counsel, as statutory public entity clauses cannot typically be waived by procurement staff
Ask the technical evaluation committee to vote on it
questions.explain: Public entities are creations of their state/local laws. Governing Law clauses mandate that lawsuits must be handled in the agency's jurisdiction under state law. Procurement staff lack the legal authority to waive sovereignty or jurisdictional venue.
